no_modal_or_listening_inference: The single-scene ImageViewerSurface seam does not certify production native/browser modal exclusion or assistive speech. Actual Android TalkBack is required; simulator/desktop/browser listening exclusions remain explicit.
scope_limits: Fixed accepted snapshots and actual shared components are verification harnesses, not random production journeys.
320px is a diagnostic width, not an approved minimum.
Dark uses a controlled Material3 dark palette with actual fonts; native production theme/palette behaviour still needs 10K.
No physical-iOS or audio-listening pass claimed.
